ellis (Docs): Flag: embeddings reference page shows response with top-level "embedding" field (single vec). Actual service returns "data" array with "embedding" per item. Also the Go snippet in the examples unmarshals into a []float64 directly. We should fix examples + add a tiny migration note.

parth (SDK): Thanks. Can you paste the broken example? I'll update Go/Python/JS snippets.

ellis (Docs): Broken response: ```json {"object":"embedding","embedding":[0.1,0.2,0.3] }``` Actual canonical: ```json {"object":"list","data":[{"object":"embedding","embedding":[0.1,0.2,0.3],"index":0}] }``` Go snippet currently: ```go var vec []float64 json.Unmarshal(respBody, &vec)``` should be parsing struct with Data[].Embedding.

nora (API): Backend uses the list envelope for consistency; we can keep accepting the old shape for a short window but docs must reflect canonical shape.

sam (QA): Adding that old snippet causes our integration tests to fail. Please update docs before next release.

parth (SDK): I'll open a PR to replace response example, fix Go unmarshalling to: `var out struct{Data []struct{Embedding []float64}}` and update Python/JS to read `resp["data"][0]["embedding"]`. Also will add migration note mapping `embedding -> data[0].embedding`.

ellis (Docs): Drafted migration blurb: "Note: older examples showed a top-level "embedding" vector. The canonical response wraps embeddings in `data[]` items: `data[0].embedding`. Update parsing accordingly. See /docs/migrations/embeddings-response."

parth (SDK): PR opened: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/2102 6 fixes: response example, Go/Python/JS snippets, migration note, and small JSON Schema. Requesting review from @ellis and @nora.

deploy-bot: docs-build: started (job 8102)

sam (QA): Ran preview, examples now match staging responses. Tests pass.

deploy-bot: docs-build: succeeded (job 8102) 0 preview: https://deploy-preview-2102--docs.redwood.ai/reference/embeddings

ellis (Docs): Reviewed and approved. Merged. Adding a changelog line under "Docs updates".

parth (SDK): Filing infra ticket to add a docs lint rule to catch top-level embedding vectors (infra#820).

ellis (Docs): Closing thread. If we see customer reports, we can add a short FAQ mapping snippet. :white_check_mark:
